events.title: Mabe Fratti
events.description:
A Belfast debut for experimental cellist and composer Mabe Fratti.

Originally from Guatemala, Fratti is now based in Mexico City.  She uses cello, voice and synthesizers to present sound in the form of installation, composition & free improvisation. Mabe’s music takes us to sensible sounding boards: through a hypnotic and captivating performance, she sews contemporary elements like shoegaze and dream pop with ancestral influences that go from Gregorian chants to Sephardi music, transforming them in ingredients of a potent sonic ritual that causes a profound emotional impact.

events.title: Haze presents DJ Love
events.description:
We’re super excited to announce that we’re bringing over DJ Love on the 1st of November for his Belfast debut.

A hardgroove master, DJ Love has already collaborated with legendary figures like Mark Broom and has seen support from the likes of Kettama, Interplanetary Criminal, Papa Nugs and Prospa.

DJ Love’s productions are fun, energetic and full of delicious percussion and old school rave stabs. Having recently released on the label HERAS, he has also seen released on Wavelengths, Beard Man and the fantastic Pretty Weird, whose boss we had over earlier in the year, Chloé Robinson! So this feels like a nice progression of an earlier party

However DJ Love is not alone. When planning this one, we thought no better man to bring along with us than local legend and techno wizkid Sean Carlin. We’re super excited to be going B2B with Sean from open until handing over the reigns to DJ Love! Expect us to be packing a USB full of hardgroove, percussive house and maybe even some speedy garage

With this one falling on the closest weekend day to Halloween, we fully encourage fancy dress here, we’ll be dressed up! So for all of you who can’t get out on a week day, we absolutely have you covered. We’re super duper excited for this one and we hope you are too. Tickets up in the bio here, only 2 releases so grab em whilst you can!

Gracing the ulster sports club wheels on the 29th of November we welcome the shrimp the myth the legend Dj Gamba joining us to see the year out in style.

Having lived for 5 years just outside of Detroit, Michigan, Gamba developed the basis of his career in sweaty college parties.
He then later moved to Barcelona in 2019 with the intention of continuing his career as an underground music artist. During his time in Barcelona, the Shrimp has been able to play for some of the city’s most iconic clubs, such as Nitsa Club (Apolo), Les Enfants, and Razzmatazz.

His very own collective/label, Simple Times, strives to create a judgement-free community filled with quirky house beats and uplifting attitude this is one you won’t want to miss.

Andy Lindsay, Neale & ByPhil who will be b2b2b for the first few hours in typical birthday fashion.

come along for the ride :)

events.description:

The launch event takes place on Friday 18th July in the limited-capacity Committee Room at Ulster Sports Club, featuring a carefully curated lineup: Famoc, PÚCA, and Myka - Belfast native artists pushing forward-thinking techno with immersive tension and sonic depth.

Expect high intensity, fast-moving Techno all night long in the Ulster Sports Club Committee Room for an intimate sweaty get together. We aim to achieve a safe space for the queer community & allies alike, so respect the dance floor, the people around you & if at any time you’re having any problems please alert us, the bouncers or USC staff.

Created for the love of the culture & love of the people, all proceeds will be donated to the Rainbow Project NI.

events.title: Moving On Music presents:BIG|BRAVE
events.description:
BIG|BRAVE’s music has been described as massive minimalism. With bursts and blends of textural distortion and feedback,  their music’s frayed edges and heavy centre is heard throughout. The potency of the band’s work is their singular artistry combining elements of traditional folk techniques and a modern deconstruction of guitar music. Gain, feedback, and amplitude are essential to 2024’s A Chaos Of Flowers, an album that builds on their ferocious 2023 album nature morte.

We can’t wait to welcome the sonic-tonic that is BIG|BRAVE to Belfast this November. Unmissable.

events.title: ADORE
events.description:
Irish trio Adore have signed to Big Scary Monsters and today release ‘Show Me Your Teeth', a track fuelled by months of sleep deprivation, recurring nightmares, and the strange clarity that comes from staring fear in the face.

With just a handful of singles to their name, Adore have already drawn attention from key tastemakers across press (The Guardian, So Young Magazine, DIY Magazine, CLASH Magazine, Louder, The Line of Best Fit, Dork Magazine, Rough Trade, Nialler9) and radio (BBC 6 Music's Steve Lamacq and John Kennedy at Radio X). ‘Show Me Your Teeth’ follows recent support runs with Chalk and Sprints, landing ahead of their first UK headline shows this month.

events.title: ARXX

events.title: Rhoda Dakar (DJ Set)

events.title: GETDOWN SERVICES
events.description: Getdown Services is Josh Law and Ben Sadler. They met at school in Minehead, Somerset and make music together at home in Bristol. Their highly lauded debut album Crisps was released in November 2023 via Breakfast Records presenting eclectic, danceable grooves and astute, hilarious put-downs of modern Britain. They are steadily carving out a name for themselves and building momentum over the past 18 months, with balls-to-the-wall live performances and prestigious shows with Pip Blom, Fat Dog, The Bug Club, Donny Benet, and Antony Szmierek - among many others. The band completed their biggest ever sold out headline UK tour in autumn 2024 after their vastly praised new EP release “Your Medal’s In The Post”, out on November 14th 2024, followed closely by their first ever sold out EU tour in January 2025. Off the back of extensive BBC 6Music support from the likes of Craig Charles, Huw Stephens, and Cerys Matthews, and armed with an arsenal of red-hot hits, Getdown Services look set to gobble the world up, one crumb at a time.

events.title: THE FYNCHES
events.description:
The Fynches are an Irish folk-rock band that evoke the golden age of

hard-hitting melodicism. They balance early-70s swagger with an elevated

folk sensibility, showcasing a love for rich vocal harmonies, musing

lyricism, and catchy choruses.

The brainchild of Ferdia Walsh-Peelo (lead vocals and guitar) and Oisín

Walsh-Peelo (vocals and keys - to same but two), The Fynches also

comprise Camryn Teehan (drums), Fionn O’Neill (bass), and Julia-Maria

(cello). Vocal melodies and soulful keys meet vibrant guitar lines, soaring

strings, and a powerful rhythm section.

events.description: The Underground Youth is a British post-punk band formed in 2008. Led by Craig Dyer, the group's sound combines elements of darkwave, shoegaze, and psychedelic rock. With introspective lyrics and atmospheric melodies, their music creates a captivating and melancholic atmosphere.

Sunday (1994) are ready for their premiere. Along with their enigmatic, anonymous drummer, their sound is cinematic in the truest sense. It's music you can imagine characters running through airports to, racing after love. They’re songs for bedroom floor tears or the first time two hands touch. It’s a release that captures a love story, and every love story that has ever and will ever happen, in all of its sweet, daydreaming and dramatic beauty

events.title: Swim School
events.description:
Fronted by Alice Johnson, swim school are building a name for themselves for driving guitar riffs, grungy vocals and unforgettable live performances.

The Edinburgh-based three-piece have become one of the most electrifying acts in the indie rock genre since their inception in late 2018. Hailed by BBC Radio 1 as “the band that everyone in the scene has their eye on,” their anthemic sound and emphatic lyrics have struck a chord with fans and critics alike. 

A Shine production.

events.title: Cliffords
events.description:
It’s been a busy and exciting few months for fast-rising Cork indie-rock group, Cliffords as they introduced themselves to the wider world with their second EP, 'Salt of the Lee'. It’s the sound of a band who made their initial moves outside of the glare of the music industry, and whose self-financed debut EP landed with much promise but without any pressure of expectation beyond their own. Salt of the Lee fulfils all that promise emphatically, and another thrilling next step for a band who are quickly on the rise.

Whilst Cliffords certainly continue to develop and discover both themselves as a band and their sound, they’ve already become a compelling proposition whose word-of-mouth live shows are the sound of a band on the brink of something very special.

A Shine production

events.title: Rianne Downey
events.description:
The wonderful Rianne Downey releases her eagerly anticipated debut album 'The Consequence of Love'. Born in Belshill, just outside Glasgow, Rianne grew up on a steady diet of Patsy Cline, June Carter, Townes Van Zandt, Joni Mitchell and Fleetwood Mac. More recently she’s been influenced by Sierra Ferrel, Noah Kahan and First Aid Kit.

Rianne Downey spent much of last year touring with Paul Heaton while also establishing her own fanbase with a series of solo shows. Both live and on record, her voice is a thing of beauty. And her songs are the perfect vehicle for it.

A Shine production

events.title: Bronagh Gallagher - Cathedral Quarter Arts Festival
events.description:
‘I have adored and collected disco records all my life.

I am a child of the 70s and have deep admiration for the extraordinary productions from Quincy Jones to The Bee Gees, from Nile Rogers and Allen Toussaint to Winston Monseque and Motown to name but a few. They have created some of the most loved and celebrated productions of the 20th century.

The dance floor is a place of union and love of people, the celebration of dance and the human body, and the unification of people with no judgement, borders, racism or homophobia.

So here is my humble offering to the dancefloor.’

events.title: Freak Slug
events.description:
Freak Slug - the project of UK multi-disciplinarian Xenya Genovese - today shares her latest single ‘Blue Eyes’, set to feature on her forthcoming EP Loose Tooth And A Short Skirt out on Nov 7 via Future Classic.

When Freak Slug crawls down into the weeds of the human experience, documenting life’s messiest, knottiest parts, people connect to it just as much as when she creates out in the sun - see her viral early hit ‘Radio’, with 24 million Spotify streams and counting. There’s still a rich seam of melody to be found, and an innate way with a hook, but Genovese isn’t afraid to tap into the more uncomfortable parts of her brain too. And now, new EP Loose Tooth and a Short Skirt goes one further, leaning into her roots with a release that bridges the gap into a whole new forthcoming era.

Including BBC Album of the Week, RTE Lyricfeature, and an “unexpected gem” nod from folk legend Paul Brady.

Creating music that draws from his perspective of the world, life experience, cultural roots and political beliefs he has quickly cultivated a reputation for his versatility, raw energy & powerful live performances.

events.description:
Los Angeles rock band Allah-Las will play Belfast’s Ulster Sports Club on 1 September 2026.

The astonishingly good LAELA NEALE has been added as special guest of LA's amazing ALLAH LAS at Belfast’s Ulster Sports Club on 1 September

“A ship in harbor is safe, but that’s not what ships are built for” the saying goes. But suppose the proverbial harbor is Los Angeles — a place not particularly known for being the origin of adventures. From the Spanish Conquistadors to the countless starry-eyed nobodies hoping to make it big, LA is usually the destination.

So it’s no wonder the Allah Las became fascinated with both the carefree spirit and glitter-in-the-gutter lifestyle of their hometown. After three records mining its lore and lure (from the desert to the sea) they have become global ambassadors of not just a place but a location.

events.description: Adult DVD announce their signing to legendary independent label Fat Possum. The Leeds based six-piece also today share new single “Real Tree Lee” which premiered yesterday evening on Huw Stephens' BBC 6Music show. “Real Tree Lee” is a glimpse of what to expect from Adult DVD in 2026 - bold, forward-thinking music from one of the UK's most hotly tipped new bands.

events.title: SexyTadhg
events.description: The bi-lingual songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, DJ and fashion designer, no matter the medium, SexyTadhg’s artistry is an exhilarating journey that defies expectations.

events.title: SOFY
events.description: Leicester-raised artist, SOFY, picked up a pen and started work on her collection of songs in 2021, throwing herself headfirst into music after being placed on furlough. Her hip-hop inspired indie-pop bops quickly earned her recognition among top industry tastemakers such as Clara Amfo, Jess Iszatt, & Gemma Bradley.

events.title: Tigercub
events.description: Tigercub are from different corners of the UK, making hard abrasive pop in Brighton. Their vision fine-tuned, Tigercub deliver songs of existence, abstraction and humorous disposition of modern-day. Tigercub welcome the impending and inevitable, with open arms and a pinch of salt.

events.title: Good Health Good Wealth
events.description: London based alternative duo Good Health Good Wealth’s sound pairs their fluid mix of spoken word flows and colourful imagery with animated guitar riffs, setting them in the new breed of artists defying genre-norms, with influences from the likes of N.E.R.D and OutKast to Baxter Dury and The Clash. Formed by vocalist, songwriter and producer Bruce Breakey and guitarist and producer Simon Kuzmickas, the duo explore life in contemporary England, navigating relationships, stereotypes and the colourful schemes and situations dealt with by everyday working people.

Hosted in intimate venues close to our hearts, each event is built around exceptional sound, immersive production, and the unmistakable underground ASW experience.

Blending heartfelt lyricism with soaring melodies, Haiver’s sound moves between the intimate and the anthemic, weaving stories of loss, resilience and the fragile beauty of starting again.

events.title: Now Press Play Film Festival - The Sounds of David Lynch - SOLD OUT -
events.description:
For David Lynch, sound was never an accompaniment to the image—it was the image’s unseen force. The Sound of David Lynch is a cinematic journey into the haunting sonic landscapes that define one of cinema’s most visionary filmmakers, exploring how music, noise and silence shape emotion, memory and dream.

Through iconic sequences from Eraserhead, Blue Velvet, Twin Peaks, Lost Highway, Mulholland Drive and Inland Empire, alongside rare interviews and documentary excerpts from The Sound of Lynch and Eraserhead Stories, the event reveals the creative process behind Lynch’s unmistakable audio universe.

Discover the groundbreaking collaborations that made these worlds possible: the unsettling industrial soundscapes of sound designer Alan Splet; the lush, melancholic scores of composer Angelo Badalamenti; the dream-pop textures of Julee Cruise; the hypnotic musical performances curated by longtime music supervisor Dean Hurley; and Lynch’s own work as composer, musician and sound artist.

This documentary explores how Lynch transformed sound into a narrative language—one capable of expressing the uncanny, the sublime and the unknowable.

events.title: Chris Watson
events.description:
Chris Watson is a DJ, artist and music producer.

After starting his DJ career in 2014, he has built a strong reputation and is now a sought-after name and ticket seller, drawing crowds who connect with his distinctive blend of house music and nostalgic dance sounds.

Inspired by the classic eras of dance music, his sets are known for their infectious energy and emotional depth, seamlessly bridging past and present. His online presence is equally powerful, with his videos attracting millions of viewers worldwide and resonating with both long-time fans and a new generation discovering dance music.

events.title: Milo Korbenski
events.description: Milo Korbenski is a shadowy, anonymous solo musician only publicly seen in a featureless white mask. However, his deeply expressive take on lo-fi slacker indie invokes a heartfelt intimacy, singing straight from the soul. A true auteur, and inexhaustibly prolific, Milo recorded, designed and self-released a number of albums before releasing the raucous ‘When you Gonna Tell ‘Em the Truth, Aaron?’ with Brighton based label Phantom Limb. His music is defined by eerie undertones, stretching out through a multitude of catchy-as-hell hooks, clever lyrical wordplay, and deceptively lean instrumentation that belies its own simplicity.

events.title: Simple Things
events.description:
Simple Things are a Kerry based, folk/pop three piece, featuring vocalist/rhythm guitarist Dylan, bass guitarist and backing vocalist Shane and accordion/ keyboard player Kealan Cahill. 

Both Kealan & Dylan started out their journey in music playing Irish traditional music together, before developing and exploring new territories in pop music. Shane joined the band in early 2023 with an indie influenced background. 

They bring a fresh new flavour to pop music, with a traditional Irish influence.

events.title: Iceage
events.description:
ver 18 years and five studio albums, with each evolutionary jump and a new vein of existing, Iceage have worked inside the idea of collapse. That collapse, or the thrill of being close to it, was a way of playing, singing and writing—a tumbling through life in song, catching it as it falls. Throughout the Danes’ sixth studio album, For Love of Grace & the Hereafter, there’s another layer of sparkle to the band.

Passion and romantic love has typically framed Iceage’s songs as a form of resistance, yet throughout For Love of Grace & the Hereafter, it flows pure and unafraid. It’s both fun and as serious as ever, growing and glowing through love. Produced and mixed by the band (Elias Rønnenfelt, Dan Kjær Nielsen, Jakob Tvilling Pless, Johan S. Weith, and Casper Morilla Fernandez) and Nis Bysted, the album is bright and energetic.

This next step sounds like running, but in a new direction; running to be somewhere and with someone, rather than running away or into the fire.
